title: Momo Run
one_line: A 3D endless runner: dash, jump and duck down a cobblestone road, solo or racing up to 3 friends online.
how_to_play: Computer: Space or Up to jump, Down to duck, Left and Right to change lanes. Phone: swipe up, down, left or right, or tap to jump. Race online: create a room and share the code, or join a friend's room.
description: Momo is a little pink runner with a glowing antenna and a big appetite for gems. Jump over boulders and fallen logs, duck under wooden gates, switch lanes around crate stacks and dodge rolling barrels. Run through the FINISH gate to clear a level, grab the bonus, and the next level is a little faster under a brand-new sky: Sunny Meadow, Golden Sunset, Rainy Forest, a Thunderstorm with lightning, Snowfall, Misty Dawn and a Starry Night full of fireflies. Every weather has its own music, gems chime higher when you chain them, and your best score is saved. Race online with 2 to 4 friends anywhere: everyone runs the same road with the same gems, sees the others as colored ghost runners, and the most points after 2 minutes wins.
